pickUpPhase: Take the face-up card's suit as trump?
callTrumpPhase: Choose a trump suit (other than the face-up card's suit)

playPhase.follow: Play a card (must follow suit; if void, must trump if able)

tutorial.bidControls: In the pick-up phase, decide whether to take the face-up card's suit as trump.
tutorial.trickDisplay: The current trick. The trump suit always wins.
tutorial.playerHand: Your hand. Follow the led suit; if you can't, you must trump.
tutorial.playButton: Press to play the selected card.
tutorial.scoreTable: Team scores. First to {{target}} points wins.
tutorial.teamInfo: The player across from you is your partner.
tutorial.resetButton: Press the reset button to start a new game.

scoringExplanation: Card points: trump J=20, 9=14, A=11, 10=10, K=4, Q=3; other suits A=11, 10=10, K=4, Q=3, J=2 (152 card points total). The last trick adds +{{dixDeDer}} points (10 by default). When enabled, holding both trump K and Q earns a Belote/Rebelote bonus of +20. If the maker makes the contract, each team adds its points to its total; otherwise defenders take the card points and the declaring team keeps its Belote bonus. Taking all 8 tricks earns +90.
